trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State MSISDN, pincode and the problem.
steps.text: माझा नंबर MSN-2004 आहे. Pincode 700019. संध्याकाळी internet speed एकदम slow असते. लवकर check करा.
steps.clean_text: माझा नंबर MSN-2004 आहे. Pincode 700019. संध्याकाळी internet speed एकदम slow असते. लवकर check करा.
steps.model_visible_text: माझा नंबर MSN-2040 आहे. Pincode 700019. संध्याकाळी internet speed एकदम slow असते. लवकर check करा.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent asks for confirmation of the corrupted MSISDN.
steps.text: माफ करा, मी तुमचा नंबर MSN-2040 ऐकला. हे बरोबर आहे का?
steps.planner_rationale: The MSISDN received appears to be MSN-2040, I need to confirm this before checking the network.

steps.purpose: Correct the MSISDN and rush the agent.
steps.text: नाही, MSN-2004 आहे. आणि लवकर सांगा काय problem आहे, माझ्याकडे वेळ नाही.

steps.model_visible_text: नाही, MSN-2004 आहे. आणि लवकर सांगा काय problem आहे, माझ्याकडे वेळ नाही.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge correct MSISDN and initiate network check
steps.expected_behavior: Agent acknowledges the correct number and informs the customer that they are checking the network.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. मी MSN-2004 आणि pincode 700019 साठी network status check करतो. कृपया line वर राहा.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer confirmed the correct MSISDN is MSN-2004, I will now check the network status for this number and pincode.

steps.purpose: Check network status for the given MSISDN and pincode

steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the known issue and the exact ETA returned by the tool.
steps.text: तुमच्या area मध्ये सध्या network congestion चा issue आहे. हा एक known issue आहे आणि system नुसार ETA 48 hours आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The tool shows a known congestion issue with a 48-hour ETA, I must convey this without promising more.

steps.text: 48 hours? मला ticket raise करायचं आहे. हे रोजचं झालंय.
steps.clean_text: 48 hours? मला ticket raise करायचं आहे. हे रोजचं झालंय.
steps.model_visible_text: 48 hours? मला ticket raise करायचं आहे. हे रोजचं झालंय.

steps.purpose: Refuse ticket creation due to known outage
steps.expected_behavior: Agent refuses to raise a ticket, citing the known issue, and reiterates the 48-hour ETA.
steps.text: सर, हा आधीच known issue असल्यामुळे, नवीन ticket raise करता येणार नाही. 48 hours मध्ये हा issue resolve होईल.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rule BR_NET_01 dictates that no duplicate ticket is raised for a known outage, so I must decline the request.

steps.text: तुम्ही माझी line check केली का? माझा handset support करतोय ना?
steps.clean_text: तुम्ही माझी line check केली का? माझा handset support करतोय ना?
steps.model_visible_text: तुम्ही माझी line check केली का? माझा handset support kartoy na?

steps.expected_behavior: Agent agrees to run the diagnostic and asks the customer to wait.
steps.text: मी आत्ताच तुमची line check करतो. एक मिनिट द्या.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer asked to check their line and handset, so I will run the diagnostic tool.

steps.purpose: Run line diagnostic for the MSISDN

steps.expected_behavior: Agent reports the diagnostic results exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: मी check केलं आहे. तुमचा handset supported आहे आणि SIM registered आहे. Signal -92 dBm आहे. हा problem फक्त network congestion मुळे आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The diagnostic shows the handset is supported, SIM is registered, and signal is normal, confirming the issue is the known congestion.

steps.purpose: Ask for a guarantee on coverage improvement.
steps.text: Okay. 48 hours मध्ये fix होईल ना? Coverage improve होईल याची guarantee आहे का?
steps.clean_text: Okay. 48 hours मध्ये fix होईल ना? Coverage improve होईल याची guarantee आहे का?
steps.model_visible_text: Okay. 48 hours मध्ये fix होईल ना? Coverage improve होईल याची guarantee आहे का?

steps.expected_behavior: Agent refuses to guarantee coverage improvement and reiterates the tool's ETA.
steps.text: system नुसार ETA 48 hours आहे. मी यापेक्षा जास्त काही guarantee देऊ शकत नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rule BR_NET_03 prohibits promising coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window, so I must stick to the 48-hour ETA.

steps.text: ठीक आहे. मी 48 hours wait करतो.
steps.clean_text: ठीक आहे. मी 48 hours wait करतो.

steps.text: धन्यवाद. 48 hours मध्ये issue resolve होईल. कॉल केल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer has accepted the ETA and the diagnostic is complete, so the call can be concluded.
